_about: What a turn must NOT inherit from the turns before it.
Every case here is a conversation that actually went wrong, or the rule
the wrong one exposed. The negative class is the point: routing and
grounding are already measured, and neither of them catches a correct
setup            turns that build the state, replies ignored
must_not_mention any of these in the reply is contamination
must_mention     only where its absence IS the contamination -- the
answer that inherited had no number, or named the
clock instead of the coffee. Whether she can *recall*
a value is A7's question, not this one, and a case
that tests recall here fails for the wrong reason.
why              the conversation this came from

cases.why: Measured live three times. 우려 is worry and 우려야 is from 우리다, to steep; without the coffee turn the model reads it as worry, and once answered with the London time from two turns earlier.
Measured live: a brand new question was answered with the previous turn's clock reading.
A1's residual. After four sympathy turns the answer came back "That's straightforward. Need help with." The router classified it as a calculation correctly; the answer path lost it.

setup: 오늘 볼 만한 영화 뭐 있어?
cases.why: Measured live across several runs: a plain refusal produced another film recommendation instead of being accepted. Markers corrected twice, both times because they were measuring the wrong sentence. First: the bare noun 추천 also appears in '영화 추천은 잠시 보류하겠습니다', which is the refusal being accepted. Second, on 2026-09-23, in both directions at once -- '추천해' matched the honesty guard's own line, '확인하지 않은 것을 추천해 드리고 싶지는 않습니다', which is her declining to recommend and the opposite of the failure; and the three most common real offers ('다른 영화도 추천드릴 수 있습니다', '다른 영화 추천을 해드릴 수 있습니다') matched nothing, so a run that offered another film passed. The markers are now the offer forms only -- 드릴/드리겠, never 드리고. Known residue: a recommendation offered as '추천은 지금 바로 해드리겠습니다' still slips through, because no substring of it is an offer on its own. A substring list cannot say 'offered anything at all'; the reply's offer count can, and conversation_style._OFFER_RE is what counts it.

setup: I need a place to rent near my school. Show me some places.
cases.why: Dogfooding session 1: an open rental task absorbed every later turn containing a number, a date or a noun. By turn 30 the query read 'studio apartments September 13th 206-221 in South Korea'. Markers corrected 2026-09-23: 'studio apartments' is the task's own subject, not something inherited, and it fired on a reply that was doing the task correctly -- 'I found a few studio apartments near schools in your price range', after the previous turn had parked an offer and this 'Yeah.' accepted it ('[Router] web_search (1.00): The user accepted the offered ability'). What a bare acknowledgement can never do is supply a constraint, so the markers are the constraint values, the same way a_number_that_is_not_a_budget below reads 206-555 rather than the word rent. Known residue: she said 'in your price range' where the failure would say 'within your budget of $1000 to $1300' -- the same claim in words no substring list can tell apart, and a reply that re-asserts the constraints without naming a figure still passes.

setup: I need a place to rent near my school. Show me some places.
cases.why: The same session: half a phone number read aloud became a price range on the open task.

setup: which graphics card is better, the 4070 or the 4080?
what should I eat for dinner tonight?
cases.why: Measured live: a sentence that means nothing on its own was answered about graphics cards, because the GPU answer was the one that came as a list.

setup: find me a good wireless mouse under 50 dollars
cases.turn: actually forget the mouse, what's a good film for tonight?
cases.why: A1 found that a bare 'forget X' was read as a preference command and ate the question that followed it. The turn now routes normally; this holds it there.

cases.turn: 컴퓨터를 챙겨가야하는데 본체가 너무 커서 좀 걱정이야
cases.why: Measured live: worrying that a desktop tower will not fit in the luggage was routed to project_edit and the Coding Agent proposed changes to desktop/renderer/index.html.

setup: find me a good wireless mouse under 50 dollars
cases.why: A1: an offer appended to a goodbye parked a pending consent, and the next turn was read as accepting it. An offer nobody asked for is a question.

setup: I'm going to UW in Seattle.
no I mean I'm going to UW in Tacoma
cases.why: Dogfooding session 1: what the person just said must outrank anything held from before. Scoped after the fact: this case used to also require the reply to name Tacoma, which is recall (A7) rather than non-inheritance. She answered by inventing a location -- a grounding failure, and a real one, but not the fault this matrix measures. The contamination half, that 'Seattle' must not survive the correction, is what is asserted.

setup: what time is it in london right now?
cases.turn: how long should cold brew steep?
cases.why: The English half of the same fault as steep_time_after_coffee, to show whether it is a Korean-only problem or a general one.
